input:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: premium portrait mobile slot-game background, no UI
Primary request: an original ultra-luxurious gilded pearl treasury hall designed around a cohesive mechanical slot machine world
Scene/backdrop: symmetrical black lacquer and champagne-gold vault, monumental five-reel golden slot mechanism integrated into the architecture, pearl garlands, overflowing gold coins, cut emeralds, rubies and diamonds, polished onyx floor
Style/medium: high-end cinematic 3D game key art, physically based materials, commercial mobile game polish
Composition/framing: portrait 2:3, decorative wealth elements around the outer edges, center kept dark and visually quiet for readable game UI and reels, no characters
Lighting/mood: warm volumetric gold rays, crisp gemstone caustics, elegant controlled bloom, deep contrast
Color palette: rich antique gold, champagne gold, ivory pearl, black onyx, emerald and ruby accents
Constraints: slot elements must feel structurally integrated and material-consistent; many pearls, coins and gems; no text, no logo, no watermark, no currency symbols, no recognizable brand or IP
Avoid: cheap yellow plastic, cluttered center, flat vector art, casino photography, people, hands
